items.briefing:
New research from Commvault highlights a concerning trend: one in three organisations across Australia and New Zealand are still paying ransomware demands, despite expert advice against it. This comes as global ransomware attacks on industrial organisations reached over 1,100 incidents in just the second quarter of 2026. Separately, a NSW government audit has found major agencies are repeatedly failing the same cybersecurity controls year after year, suggesting systemic issues rather than isolated gaps.

For staff at training organisations, the key takeaway is simple — ransomware affects all sectors, including education. **If you receive an unexpected email asking you to open a file or click a link, verify it with the sender before acting.**

featured.title: One in three ANZ organisations still pay ransomware demands, Commvault research says
featured.quote: One in three ANZ organisations still paying ransomware demands despite known risks.
